maya: Heads-up — prepping EU micro-launch (canary) this Wed 09:30 UTC. Need release note snippet + internal announce. Pin versions: v2.3.1-quant and fallback v2.2.9. Who can draft copy? @liam @jen
liam: I'll draft the internal blurb. Can we aim for <50 words? Also canary thresholds: error rate <0.5%, p95 latency <120ms. If breach -> rollback -> timeline?
jen: Rollback criteria: 1) error rate >0.8% for 5m OR 2) sustained 4xx increase + eval regression on the smoke set. Rollback path: immediate pin to v2.2.9, scale down new canaries, and alert oncall.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy queued by @maya for 2024-05-15T09:30:00Z (job id db-8712). Commands:
```
/deploy canary --model v2.3.1-quant --region eu --window 30m --notify #eng-oncall
```
maya: tagging @sam-oncall for oncall handoff. Also need release-note snippet for #internal-announce and a short ops checklist (rollout owner, metric dashboard link).
sam-oncall: I'm oncall Wed 08:30-16:30 UTC. I'll own the first 60m. Link dashboards: https://grafana.company/redwood/canary-eu
liam: Draft blurb:
"Launching EU canary for v2.3.1-quant Wed 09:30 UTC. Expect short warm-up traffic; if you see errors or latency regressions, ping @sam-oncall and ops. Rollback policy: auto-pin to v2.2.9 if error rate spikes or regressions detected."
jen: minor edit: change \"auto-pin\" -> \"immediate pin and fallback to v2.2.9\". Also add note about embargo until 10:30 UTC.
maya: adding deploybot cue to internal message. Assuming approvals: @liam +1, @jen +1?
liam: +1 :thumbsup: \\njen: +1
maya: cool. final steps: I'll pin the release note in #eng-releases 15min before deploy and start the canary via deploy-bot. Anyone else want to review copy?
deploy-bot: deploy job db-8712 moved to \"ready\" state. Notify on /deploy start. :robot_face: 
sam-oncall: I'll shadow the live metrics and run the smoke prompt set at T+10m.
maya: thx all. copying final blurb below for paste into internal announce:
\"INTERNAL: EU canary launch for v2.3.1-quant — Wed 09:30 UTC. Owner: @sam-oncall. Fallback: v2.2.9. Metrics: p95 <120ms, errors <0.5%. Embargo until 10:30 UTC. If thresholds breach -> immediate pin & rollback. See dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/canary-eu\"
liam: I'll queue that in the draft channel and schedule pinning.
jen: also added a quick eval script in the repo: https://git.company/redwood/evals/tree/eu-canary-smoke
maya: great. closing — will post final announce 15m prior. :rocket:
